subject: prd/docgate
statement: After a rebase checkpoint passes FR-35, docgate shall materialize every binding addressable row as one live checkpoint-origin fold-state and source-map record.
rationale: rendered rows without fold state caused the dangling-target remedies and stale source map that motivated this amendment
fit_criterion: a checkpoint containing at least one row from every FR-41 addressable table-schema prefix yields the same complete ID set in the projection, live fold state, and source map, with checkpoint origin on every record
